title: Exterior Painting in Ocala, FL | Stucco, Siding & Trim
description: Exterior painting in Ocala, FL built for intense sun and summer storms. Elastomeric on stucco, 100% acrylic on siding, and up to a 10-year written warranty.
h1: Exterior Painting in Ocala, FL That Stands Up to Sun and Storms
heroIntro: Ocala exteriors take hard UV on the south and west walls and months of humid, stormy weather. We prep and coat each elevation for the exposure it actually gets.

sections.h2: Read the elevations before you pick the paint
body: On most Ocala houses, the south and west walls tell the real story. Those elevations take the afternoon sun, so pigment chalks and fades there long before the shaded north side shows wear. Meanwhile, the lower foot of siding and stucco catches rain splash and sprinkler overspray, and that constant dampness invites algae and soft wood. Good exterior painting in Ocala, FL starts with photographing every elevation and pricing the repairs each one actually needs. Our article on sun damage and paint restoration in Ocala shows what to look for.

sections.h2: Ocala substrates and how we coat them
body: Stucco is common in places like Silver Springs Shores and Marion Oaks, and hairline cracks are typical. We clean and fill those cracks, then apply elastomeric coating, which flexes with small movement instead of splitting. Larger stucco damage is handled through our stucco repair and painting service.

Wood trim, porch columns, and siding in the historic districts around Tuscawilla and Historic Downtown need scraping to a sound edge, rot replacement where boards have gone soft, and primer on any bare wood. Siding and trim then get premium 100% acrylic. Mid-century block homes get careful caulking along fascia and window joints, plus a breathable acrylic system on the masonry.

body: Our preferred exterior season runs October through May, when humidity drops and afternoon storms are rare. Summer projects still happen, but crews start early, track dew point and radar, and stop before coatings can be rained on. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time. Most jobs start one to three weeks after approval. sections.h2: Warranty and what you sign at the end
body: Exterior work carries a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty. The exact product line is named on your estimate. Before we close out, you walk the house with the crew lead and sign the punch list, and anything not right is fixed first. We leave labelled touch-up paint for each color.
Learn more about our exterior painting service, pair the job with Ocala pressure washing, or return to the Ocala location page.

faqs.q: Can you paint my Ocala home's exterior in summer?
faqs.a: Yes, with adjustments. Crews start earlier in the day and watch dew point and radar. October through May is still the easiest window for exterior work.

faqs.q: Do you replace rotted trim before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Rot and fascia replacement are part of our prep, and anything we find is priced from walkthrough photos on the written estimate, not added later without your approval.

faqs.q: Will one coat be enough to refresh my Ocala exterior?
faqs.a: Our baseline is two full coats. Dramatic color changes or porous surfaces such as weathered stucco get a third.

faqs.q: Do you paint outbuildings on Ocala horse properties?
faqs.a: Yes. Barns and outbuildings can be added to the same estimate as the residence, with the product chosen for each surface.
